title: Principal Handoff 0.2 event envelope
description: Fields shared by every Principal Handoff event, whatever its extension. Receivers MUST ignore properties they do not know.

ext.description: Extension and version that defines this event type, e.g. tasks/0.2.

id.description: Event id; stable across retransmissions of the same event. Receivers deduplicate on it.

type.description: Event type, defined by the extension named in ext.

origin.description: Which role emitted the event; the extension defines the roles.

key.description: Opaque identifier of the item (task or question) the event is about.

ts.description: RFC 3339 timestamp at which the event was created.

text.description: The item's text: a task as declared, or a question as asked.

due.description: Calendar date by which the principal should act.

context.description: Free-form tag for why the item was sent (e.g. a bulk import).

decided_by.description: On a resolution: principal, or assistant when made on the principal's behalf without confirmation.

note.description: Free text from the emitting role.
